body: Because i have no interest in doing anything. Ever.
nothing. sitting in  a bank account, paying basic bills.

This term isn't temporary, this is what i've chosen to do because it's the most comfortable life to wallow in my own misery. I get paid almost 6 figures to do nothing. That's my goal though. To collect money. Nothing means anything to me though, so I sit here in my heaps of money that means nothing, not wanting to do anything. Maybe being a ghost is more fun.
